A riverside school known by many names will be gone – but not forgotten.

by Raquel Villatoro, The Waco Bridge
February 25, 2026

After bulldozers this spring tear down the former Indian Spring Middle School near the Brazos River, all that will be left are half a century of memories of its former students.

It’s those memories the City of Waco and Waco Independent School District leaders hope to preserve.

Since the campus opened as Jefferson-Moore High School in 1972, it has served five schools educating students at every grade level.

The City of Waco last fall bought the empty school and adjacent track for $32.2 million to make way for a $213 million downtown redevelopment. ...
